title: Port session subscription snapshot and ordered teardown
scope: Complete watchSession over owned session source arrays, an ordered plugin-store snapshot, also stores and native Watchable callbacks. Preserve identity deduplication, snapshot-before-subscribe order, listener identity, partial subscribe failure and repeated ordered teardown.
acceptance: Full original watchSession compares successful/empty subscriptions, callback faults, listener identity and retained partial state before Rust.
Source registration callbacks supply actual original plugin store metadata; native plugin registry wiring remains explicit. Host admission precedes all subscribe callbacks.
open_items: Native plugin busy registry must supply its current ordered store-array snapshot; actual plugin registration and full engine wiring remain separate.
Owned readonly store arrays and typed callbacks exclude arbitrary JS property/prototype mutation. Actual browser watch runtime remains required.
